repos_data.description: BuntDB is an embeddable, in-memory key/value database for Go with custom indexing and geospatial support
NuDB: A fast key/value insert-only database for SSD drives in C++11
An in-memory key:value store/cache (similar to Memcached) library for Go, suitable for single-machine applications.
Lightweight, fast and reliable key/value storage engine based on Bitcask.
LibraDB is a simple, persistent key/value store written in pure Go in less than 1000 lines for learning purposes.
A simple, fast, embeddable, persistent key/value store written in pure Go. It supports fully serializable transactions and many data structures such as  list, set, sorted set.
Ultra High-performance Lightweight Embedded and Server OLTP RDBMS✨

TiDB is built for agentic workloads that grow unpredictably, with ACID guarantees and native support for transactions, analytics, and vector search. No data silos. No noisy neighbors. No infrastructure ceiling.
Fast thread-safe inmemory cache for big number of entries in Go. Minimizes GC overhead

repo_meta_data.description: Simply ACID* key-value database. At the medium or even low latency it tries to provide greater throughput without losing the ACID properties of the database. The database provides the ability to create record headers at own discretion and use them as transactions. The maximum size of stored data is limited by the size of the computer's RAM.
